title: Fresh-profile Archipelago live validation (protected dadap sessions, profile ap1, seed ap-fresh-20261006a)
method: dadap play on a brand-new AP profile (tutorial played in vanilla first), local AP server, all native families in protected test mode. Originals parked/restored byte-for-byte after every session (139 files verified).

findings: All five missions are selectable at New Game; access hook only needs to remove missions.
Free starting skills: Double Time, Fever Rush, Let's Dance (Charlie).
Default-owned at start: 5 outfit items, 3 dances (incl. one debug-only dance); Tutorial and Lets Dance achievement complete during tutorial.
Beating Hemlock awards the Bass Invader power; Idol skill trees appear only after that Idol's boss is beaten.
Fresh save has 3 scope contexts (Global, Playthrough, GameLoop); some variables are created lazily; slot name PagodaPT_M_0.

verified_live.node_purchase_is_check: Buying Heavy Kick: credits spent, node shown purchased, node-interaction journaled, AP check sent+confirmed, native reward removed (unequip, reflected-set removal, no leaked applied effect).
verified_live.skill_grant: AP-delivered Heavy Kick natively granted and equipped via the native toggle; effect works in a mission and persists across title/Continue.
verified_live.mission_access: Only the starting mission playable at first; Arora Access delivered via AP unlocked Arora; persisted across reload.
verified_live.power_award: Beating Hemlock: vanilla power award journaled as the Bass Invader node check, slot gated; unreceived power could not be equipped; after AP delivery it equipped and fired in a mission.
verified_live.traps: Half Heart: exactly -5 HP, MaxHealth unchanged (two applications). Silence: attack/dodge/abilities inhibited 10 s, movement allowed, restored automatically.
verified_live.deathlink_incoming: Natural 5-HP damage hits across services drove 40->0; game death handler ran, normal death screen/Retry; remote death not echoed; no unearned mission completion.
verified_live.deathlink_outgoing: One local death produced exactly one outgoing DeathLink.
verified_live.checks: 10 checks from Hemlock (completion on Easy, 1-3 stars, achievements, power node) submitted and confirmed; 13 hint/filler/etc items received and applied.
verified_live.reconcile: Ledger resumed across four sessions; entitlements published before launch prevent the startup removal race.

defects_found_and_fixed_during_validatio: Startup removal of an already-received skill before the client connected (now: entitlements published from the ledger before launch).
GE_Healing_SetByCaller CDO shape refused; Half Heart/DeathLink now use the verified GE_Damage_SetByCaller (capped hits).
Native RemoveOwnedUpgrade re-grants other removed powers and the game re-grants powers on its own: powers are gated by slot/applied effect, skills removed via reflected set.
Grant did not equip: now equips through the native toggle like a vanilla purchase.
~80 ms/tick unmeasured asset-path scan: cached (median tick now 32 ms).
Client crash on Windows sharing violation during snapshot swap.

performance.user_reported_freezes: none noticed after the scan cache fix

not_validated: Dex/Prophet/Dahlia access items (same mechanism as Arora, not individually exercised).
Silence cleanup on death/world transition (fixture-tested only).
Half Heart at very low health (fixture-tested nonlethal clamp).
Story victory goal on this profile (earlier protected run reported story victory).
Long soak (multi-hour) and boss-fight interactions with DeathLink.

release_package_run.package: DeadAsDiscoAP-0.4.0.zip (unpacked; production mode, no test flags)
steps: dadap newprofile (tutorial only) on a brand-new profile
dadap play against the generated seed (template options, death_link on)
results: Launcher staged, launched offline, passed the network guard, issued the lease and attached the client with no manual steps.
Only the random starting mission (Hemlock) was playable.
Buying a Charlie node spent fans, showed purchased, sent the AP check, withheld the vanilla reward (not entitled), received a filler hint.
Originals restored byte-for-byte; no freezes reported.
